readings: Keep advanced behaviour records with patsim > 0.439 and join each to its transaction record (transactionrecord.transreg = advancedbehavior.translink), dropping those with no match. Group by ordertypedist, with NULL as its own group. For each group, show ordertypedist and the number of matched advanced-behaviour/transaction pairs (the join-row count, COUNT(*)). A transaction record linked to several qualifying advanced behaviour records is counted once per link.

Keep advanced behaviour records with patsim > 0.439 and join each to its transaction record (transactionrecord.transreg = advancedbehavior.translink), dropping those with no match. Group by ordertypedist, with NULL as its own group. For each group, show ordertypedist and the number of distinct matched transaction records (COUNT(DISTINCT transactionrecord.transreg)). A transaction record linked to several qualifying advanced behaviour records is counted only once.
queries:
SELECT t.ordertypedist, COUNT(*)
FROM advancedbehavior a
JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = a.translink
WHERE a.patsim > 0.439
GROUP BY t.ordertypedist;

SELECT t.ordertypedist, COUNT(DISTINCT t.transreg)
FROM advancedbehavior a
JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = a.translink
WHERE a.patsim > 0.439
GROUP BY t.ordertypedist
